reader_summary.headline: Rob's half-year letter to his co-investors in the Business Owner Fund.
reader_summary.overview: Rob's half-year letter to his co-investors in the Business Owner Fund. The letter begins with an update on the fund, detailing why the portfolio's underlying progress is significantly stronger than the first-half headline performance suggests. It continues with a post-mortem of his investment in Wix, the website-design platform.

key_points.text: How did Wix do relative to his original expectations?
The proceeds went into Constellation Software, the serial acquirer of vertical market software companies.
Rob outlines why the current pessimism around AI created the opportunity to buy a compounder at an attractive price.
